about: ROUTE R12, THE STONE PATH (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): a trail from Stonehenge's South Gate down off the stone plain through Came A Lot's north woods to the castle block's North Row, west. Its own room, 8 plots (joined to Stonehenge it would be two zones, rule 5). The path leaves the South Gate's middle (x -29.5), bends east and enters the North Row, west from the north (x -27.5). PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the design page gives 'from Came A Lot's north woods up onto the plain to the stones', so the standing stones stand on the plain plot next to the henge; the rest are the kit's pick.
